calls.statement:
WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.*, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-18' AND DATE '2025-12-28')
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) rc, sum(net_amount) net,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) datediff,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vatbad,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) x
FROM w GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3

SELECT d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dl
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND s.store_id>=900 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, rs.store_id AS return_store, ss.store_id AS sale_store, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dl, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net<>-1*0 AND r.refund_net<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_store ss ON ss.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND (rs.store_id>=900 OR ss.store_id>=900) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT count(*) n_return, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) d, sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date<f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_return_line_load WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21') stg_n,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21') fact_n
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'

calls.statement:
WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS gross_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
web_returns AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_period, w.gross_net - coalesce(r.refunds, 0) AS web_net_sales, w.gross_net, r.refunds
FROM web_sales w LEFT JOIN web_returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period)
ORDER BY 2
